mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_checkin (user_id, content, location_name, longitude, latitude, image_urls) VALUES (#{userId}, #{content}, #{locationName}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{imageUrls})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, content, location_name AS locationName, longitude, latitude, image_urls AS imageUrls, create_time AS createTime FROM user_checkin WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
